title: My neighbor parked in my assigned spot for three years, so I finally got creative
text:
I live in a small apartment building where every unit gets exactly one numbered parking spot. Mine is number 14. For three years my neighbor from unit 9 parked his huge pickup truck in my spot almost every single night, because his own spot is further from the entrance.

I tried everything. I left polite notes on his windshield. I talked to him in person twice, and both times he laughed and said he would move it 'in a minute'. He never did. The building manager told me it was 'a neighbor thing' and refused to get involved.

Last month I had enough. I ordered a professional metal sign that said 'RESERVED FOR THE OWNER OF THE BIGGEST TRUCK IN THE BUILDING - FREE PARKING, NO QUESTIONS ASKED' and mounted it above spot number 9, his spot. Then I parked in his spot every night myself.

The next morning three other neighbors with big trucks started fighting over spot 9. By the end of the week there was a waiting list taped to the wall. My neighbor came to my door furious, demanding that I take the sign down. I told him I would do it 'in a minute'.

He has parked in his own spot ever since. The sign is still up. The building manager finally called it 'a neighbor thing' again, and this time I agreed with him.
